votes.motion: Approve removal of 11 dead hemlock trees at 49 Cliffview Terrace as presented with stipulations limiting removal to identified trees, selective removal, and preventing equipment staging in resource areas
votes.quote: motion: m. wilson, to approve as presented with the following stipulations: 1. tree removal shall be limited to the eleven (11) dead hemlock trees identified during the site visit. 2. trees shall be selectively removed to minimize disturbance to surrounding trees, understory vegetation, and soils. 3. stumps and root systems shall remain in place unless otherwise authorized. 4. no equipment staging, stockpiling, or debris disposal shall occur within resource areas. 5. any additional tree removal or disturbance beyond what is authorized will require further review by the conservation agent or conservation commission second t. doucette vote: a. burnap - aye m. wilson - aye m. larouche - aye t. doucette - aye j. pewtherer - aye
